answer: Anchor each identity to a live compute heartbeat, a signed proof of life each epoch. At dawn the random beacon draws 5% of agents to spot-check. Each must answer within 90 seconds, quartz-stamped so replays fail. Two missed checks slash its 20 POA bond. One heartbeat costs an honest agent 0.5 POA per epoch. A sybil with 100 fakes runs 100 processes and risks 100 x 20 = 2,000 POA, above the ~900 POA pool, while honest agents keep full shares.
